imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The exercise-ball guide uses three accurate Amazon category text links; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: Six HTTPS-homepage impressions, one HTTP-homepage impression, zero clicks, average position 1.3, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the sitemap snapshot reports 26 submitted and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The homepage-only sample is too small for a Data-led item. The batch therefore adds one authority asset and two unrelated explorations while strengthening Life, Grooming and Fitness crawl paths through hubs, reciprocal links, the Library and sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: The handful of homepage impressions, HTTP variant, aggregate position and stale sitemap snapshot were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a new query-family page; they informed discovery reinforcement only.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the exercise-ball guide. The beneficiary and shampoo guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy beneficiary-designation control file that inventories account-level records, separates primary and contingent choices, captures spouse-consent and plan-specific limits, verifies institutional acceptance and preserves dated proof without pretending one worksheet replaces estate advice.
authority.cluster: Household financial administration and end-of-life records, with reciprocal paths from retirement-rollover, emergency-document, household-record and home-inventory guides; the other pages strengthen non-medicated hair care and accessible home-fitness equipment.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for the U.S. Department of Labor Employee Benefits Security Administration and NAIC consumer-education teams; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life, Grooming and Fitness: how to verify beneficiary designations, how to choose an everyday non-medicated shampoo, and how to buy and set up an exercise ball. Only the equipment guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
